trade.thesis: FACT: after a week of dated G10 tightening and BoC energy/CPI communication, Dec CORRA still implies only 2.58% versus overnight 2.29%. INFERENCE: the overnight path is the mispriced leg; paying COAZ26 is the mechanism that reprices if markets stop treating the minutes as a costless risk flag. UNKNOWN: whether core-near-2% and labor 38 will keep BoC on hold, and whether the Saudi workaround caps the energy tail before pass-through hits the strip. Reject receive AONIA: housing is biting (NSW stamp duty -24% y/y, volumes -18%, Sydney/Melbourne values >7% off peak) but Oct AONIA has already added +21.5bp, so that catalyst is not unpriced. Reject long USDCAD: that trades gap persistence, not repricing.

Canada August CPI held at 3% on 14 Sep while core stays near 2%, so the inflation print is live, not stale.

AONIA and SOFR have already added more near-term hike pricing than CORRA, isolating Canada as the incomplete repricing.
